description: Run the real separation engine on artwork: detected spot inks, one grayscale film-positive plate per ink (halftoned, dot-gain compensated, white underbase on dark garments) plus a composite print preview. With no key: free small preview. With free_email: ONE full separation per email address, plates delivered by email, no watermark. With api_key: metered (1 credit), plates emailed to deliver_email.

deliver_email.description: Where to email the full-resolution plates zip (defaults to free_email)

free_email.description: Email for the one-per-email FREE full separation — plates are sent there

garment.description: Shirt the art prints on: "dark" (black, default), "light" (white), a color name (Navy, Royal, Red, Maroon, Forest, Gold, Heather Grey, Charcoal, ...) or a hex like "#1f2a44". The separation is solved against that exact shirt color.

image_b64.description: Base64 (or data URL) of the artwork — alternative to image_url

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the artwork (PNG/JPG, max 12 MB)

mode.description: index = one ink per square pixel, no halftone; gray = one screen (black ink on light shirts, white on dark); sim = simulated process (default), spot = solid spot colors for flat logos, cmyk = 4-color process, dtf = DTG/DTF print file prep

palette.description: Exact ink hex codes to separate to (optional)

underbase.description: Print a white underbase (default: on for shirts darker than mid-grey)

name: separate_image
title: Run a full color separation
